name: LinkedIn Content Writer
description: Draft, revise, and review evidence-led LinkedIn posts, newsletter introductions, articles, carousel copy, and comments in a configurable voice.
author: Becky Still, Digital Boop Ltd
coverImageAlt: Blank source slips align through a cyan glass lens into one polished portrait card.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: supplied facts are focused into one clear, credible professional story without inventing evidence, represented as a single polished blank publication card built from grounded source pieces
Scene/backdrop: an uncluttered warm-paper writing field with a small centered slate composition table and no stationery or room props
Subject: several completely blank source slips aligned through one transparent cyan glass focusing lens into one clean blank portrait card, with a small orange foundation block anchoring the composition
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; centered three-quarter view at a noticeably smaller scale; contain every source slip, complete glass lens, finished card, foundation block, table, and shadow within the central 58% of the canvas; leave at least 21% calm empty border on all four sides; no object may enter the outer 16%
Lighting/mood: thoughtful, credible, human, quietly technical
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Constraints: all paper surfaces blank and unmarked; no arrows, chevrons, directional rods, social-network logos, profile silhouettes, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, hashtags, icons, logos, trademarks, or watermark; no paw imagery or paw logo; no cats or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding
